name: sentiment_split
description: Oracle refines the clustering by splitting a broad cluster on sentiment, renaming, then accepting. Should exercise split + rename + show in one healthy session.

oracle_turns.raw_text: The largest cluster mixes positive and negative reviews. Split it into two: 'Positive Reviews' for praise and 'Negative Reviews' for complaints.
Rename the cluster about books to 'Book Reviews'.
The clustering now reflects the sentiment split I wanted. No further changes.
